action.objective: Verify Qa6 as the top-scoring candidate from broad search at full depth, checking it is not a queen trap.
action.rationale: Broad depth-1 search with quiescence gave e2a6 the top exact score (95), but only at depth 1; e2b5 and e2c4 are close with upper bounds. Qa6 invades near the black king and could be a target. No queen raid should be committed without a deep single-candidate verification at max_depth.
